meta.primarySource: meowdb.com/msclassic (community database; rebranding to NiaDB late Oct/early Nov 2026)
notes: All text paraphrased. Per-level SP/AP tables come from MeowDB's sample builds (mostly Grummash's Lv70 benchmark builds) and are recommendations, not game rules.
MeowDB guides cover Lv 30-70 for 2nd jobs. Lv 71-100 SP plans are inferred (finish remaining 2nd-job skills) and flagged as such.
Third job (and El Nath/Orbis) is not in the launch build; at Lv70 you simply keep levelling as a 2nd job up to the Lv100 cap.

creation.intro: Every stat starts at 4 and you get 9 free points to place yourself. There are no dice to roll. Put 8 into your class's main stat and 1 into its second stat.

warrior.then: Levels 2 to 10: all 5 points into STR every level. You don't need DEX to job up.

magician.then: Levels 2 to 10: all 5 points into INT every level.

bowman.then: Levels 2 to 10: all 5 points into DEX every level.

thief.then: Levels 2 to 10: all 5 points into LUK every level.

creation.beginner: Skill points: as a Beginner you get 1 per level, so 9 by level 10. That's enough to max Three Snails, Recovery and Nimble Feet (3 each), so the order barely matters.
tips: Not sure which class yet? Check the tier list before you click. Fixing your points later takes an AP Reset, which costs 7,000 NX.
Your job instructor doesn't check stats in Classic, so any spread can job up at level 10. The spreads above just make Maple Island faster.

magicianPick.intro: All three start the same: Magician at level 10, then pick at level 30. Grades come from our tier list.

rows.pick: You want the easiest Magician to level alone. Poison Breath hits up to 6 monsters and Fire Arrow burns. Bring lots of mana potions.
You're in it for the long run. Thunder Bolt hits up to 6, but its group damage stays modest until 3rd job, and many Victoria Island monsters resist ice.
You'll play with friends. Heal and Bless make every party better and you're the toughest Magician, but leveling alone is slow outside undead maps.

firstJob.notes: Starting stats 12 STR / 5 DEX / 4 INT / 4 LUK. +28 HP and +12 MP per level; job advancement grants +350 HP / +150 MP. 1st-job skills in Classic: Power Strike (20), Slash Blast (20, hits up to 6, costs HP+MP), Precise Strikes (15, new: +ACC and crit rate), Improved HP Recovery (15), Max HP Increase (15, now a % of max HP, not HP-per-level), Iron Body (20). Warrior is the only class with an AoE attack before Lv30.

jobs.name: Fighter
jobs.weapon: Swords or axes (1H with shield, or 2H)
jobs.playstyle: Tough up-close fighter. Rush to bunch monsters together, Slash Blast the group, Power Strike single targets, and keep Rage and Booster running.
pros: Best damage-per-MP of the warrior branches at Lv70 in MeowDB benchmarks
Rage is a party Attack Power buff (+40 ATK at max)
Widest weapon choice (1H/2H sword and axe)
cons: Short reach and slow movement; takes lots of hits
Rage lowers your WDEF (-40 at max)
Mastery/Booster/Final Attack lock you to one weapon family
Power Guard moved to 3rd job in Classic

advancement.npc: Dances with Balrog (quest: The Warrior's Next Journey)
advancement.test: Take his letter to the Warrior Job Instructor at West Rocky Mountain IV, enter the hidden test map, kill mobs for 30 Dark Marbles, trade for The Proof of a Hero, return to Dances with Balrog and pick Fighter.

ap.summary: STR primary; keep total DEX (base + gear) only at your next weapon's requirement. Lv1-10 all STR; Lv10-30 mostly 4 STR / 1 DEX; Lv31-36 3 STR / 2 DEX; Lv37-57 4 STR / 1 DEX; Lv58+ all STR once DEX reaches 60 base.
steps: Lv1-10: all AP into STR (about 57 STR / 5 DEX at Lv10). No DEX needed to advance.
Lv10-30: ~4 STR / 1 DEX per level with a few 3/2 levels; target ~135 STR / 27 DEX at Lv30.
Lv31-36: 3 STR / 2 DEX per level (~153 STR / 39 DEX at Lv36).
Lv37-57: 4 STR / 1 DEX per level (~237 STR / 60 DEX at Lv57).
Lv58-70: all STR (~302 STR / 60 DEX at Lv70). Lv70 2H weapons need 70 total DEX; cover the rest with gear.
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): keep DEX at weapon requirement, rest STR.
Pitfall: adding DEX for damage or advancement is wasted; levels add ACC (~0.8 ACC per level vs 0.48 per DEX). Use Precise Strikes, gear and Sniper potions to fix accuracy.
Pitfall: check gear DEX before adding base DEX; you may need less than 60.

firstJob: Beginner: Three Snails 3, Recovery 3, Nimble Feet 3 by Lv10
Lv10-12: Power Strike 4, Slash Blast 3
Lv13-14: Slash Blast 4, Precise Strikes 5
Lv15-20: Power Strike to 20 (max), Slash Blast 6
Lv21-25: Slash Blast to 20 (max), Precise Strikes 6
Lv26-28: Precise Strikes to 15 (max)
Lv29-30: Improved HP Recovery 3, Max HP Increase 3
Skip: Iron Body. Don't rush Max HP Increase (no longer adds HP per level, so delaying costs nothing).
2nd-job SP cannot be spent on 1st-job skills: finish this by Lv30.
secondJob: Lv31-38: Weapon Mastery (Sword or Axe) to 20; Booster 1 at Mastery 5; Final Attack 1-2
Lv64-70: Rush to 20 (1 SP spare at 70)
Lv71-100 (inference): all Fighter skills are maxed by ~Lv70; extra SP has nowhere to go until 3rd job.
Options: Booster 10 or Rush 10 earlier for upkeep/mobility. Don't push Rush early (Rush 1 costs 35 MP). Pick sword vs axe before spending Mastery SP. Turn Final Attack off when PS already one-shots.
Classic changes: Final Attack proc 25% (was 50% in test), Rush moved into 2nd job (6 targets, 15 MP at max), Power Guard is 3rd job. Since Oct 15, Rush no longer pushes bosses.

jobs.name: Page
jobs.weapon: Swords or blunt weapons (1H with shield, or 2H)
jobs.playstyle: The tankiest melee job. Threaten slows monsters and lowers their WDEF, Rush pulls them together, then Power Strike or Slash Blast finishes them.
pros: #2 damage-per-MP at Lv70 in MeowDB benchmarks
Threaten slows up to 4 mobs and lowers their WDEF
1H + shield option with Guard blocks
Sword or blunt both viable (Titan Lv40 blunt is craftable)
cons: Short reach, low mobility
Threaten needs frequent recasts and caps at 4 mobs
Mastery/Booster/Final Attack lock you to one weapon family

advancement.npc: Dances with Balrog (quest: The Warrior's Next Journey)
advancement.test: Same Warrior test: letter to the Warrior Job Instructor at West Rocky Mountain IV, collect 30 Dark Marbles in the test map, bring The Proof of a Hero back and pick Page.

ap.summary: Same as Fighter: STR primary, DEX only to weapon requirement (3/2 to Lv36, 4/1 to Lv57, pure STR after ~60 base DEX).
steps: Lv1-30: as Warrior (~135 STR / 27 DEX at Lv30).
Lv31-36: 3 STR / 2 DEX.
Lv37-57: 4 STR / 1 DEX (~237 STR / 60 DEX).
Lv58-70: all STR (~302 STR / 60 DEX).
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): DEX to weapon req, rest STR.
Pitfall: ACC from gear/potions is not DEX and does not satisfy weapon requirements.

firstJob: Same as Warrior 1st-job plan: Power Strike 20, Slash Blast 20, Precise Strikes 15, Improved HP Recovery 3, Max HP Increase 3 by Lv30; skip Iron Body.
secondJob: Lv31-38: Blunt (or Sword) Mastery to 20, Booster 1, Threaten 1, Final Attack 2
Lv64-70: Rush to 20; spare point into the other Mastery
Lv71-100 (inference): skills effectively maxed; nothing left to put SP into until 3rd job.
Options: Threaten earlier for mob pulling; Booster 10 or Rush 10 earlier. Skip sword skills on a blunt build (and vice versa).
Classic changes: Final Attack 25% proc; Rush added to 2nd job (6 targets). Since the Oct 15 patch, Rush no longer pushes bosses.

jobs.name: Spearman
jobs.weapon: Spears or polearms (2H only, no shield)
jobs.playstyle: Melee with the longest reach. Rush to group monsters up, Power Strike or Slash Blast them, and Final Attack heals you a little as you hit.
pros: Longest basic melee reach of warrior weapons
#3 damage-per-MP at Lv70 in MeowDB benchmarks
Polearm Mastery adds +20 Speed; Spear Mastery adds 20% chance to ignore WDEF
Final Attack: Spear heals 10% of damage dealt
cons: No shield or Guard
No party buff until 3rd job (Hyper Body is Dragon Knight)
Iron Will is a weak late pick
Weapon family locks Mastery/Booster/FA

advancement.test: Same Warrior test (West Rocky Mountain IV instructor, 30 Dark Marbles, The Proof of a Hero), then pick Spearman.

ap.summary: Same as Fighter/Page. Each Lv30-70 spear/polearm needs DEX equal to its level; gear DEX lowers the base DEX you need.
steps: Lv1-30: as Warrior (~135 STR / 27 DEX).
Lv31-36: 3 STR / 2 DEX.
Lv58-70: all STR (~302 / 60 base; ~337 STR / 70 DEX with gear in the sample build).
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): DEX to weapon req, rest STR.
Pitfall: don't miss weapon and accuracy breakpoints chasing small defense gains; aim for 90-100% hit rate.

firstJob: Same as Warrior 1st-job plan (PS 20, SB 20, Precise Strikes 15, IHR 3, MHI 3).
secondJob: Lv31-38: Spear (or Polearm) Mastery to 20, Booster 1, Final Attack 3
Lv60-70: Iron Will to 30; spare point into other Mastery
Lv71-100 (inference): skills maxed; no further sinks until 3rd job.
Skip: splitting SP between spear and polearm families; early Iron Will.
Classic changes: Final Attack 25% proc; Rush in 2nd job (no longer pushes bosses since Oct 15); Iron Will gives +50 WDEF and 35% knockback resist at max.

firstJob.notes: Classic sources list Lv10 for Magician, not the old Lv8 early advancement. Advancing gives a free Beginner's Wooden Wand. Starting stats 4 STR / 4 DEX / 12 INT / 5 LUK. +16 HP / +22 MP per level; advancement +150 HP / +350 MP. INT does not add extra MP in Classic, and HP washing is not viable. 1st-job skills: Energy Bolt (20), Magic Claw (20), Magic Guard (15), Magic Armor (20), Improved MP Recovery (15), Max MP Increase (15, +25% max MP at 15).

jobs.name: Fire/Poison Wizard
jobs.playstyle: Burn and poison caster. Fire Arrow hits one target and keeps it burning, and Poison Breath spreads poison across a group.
pros: #4 AoE at Lv70 in MeowDB benchmarks
Fire Arrow bonus vs fire-weak mobs
Poison Breath explosion can hit up to 6
Meditation party M.ATK buff; Teleport and MP Eater
cons: Fire-resistant mobs blunt Fire Arrow
Poison Breath costs 40 MP at max
Low HP makes Magic Guard upkeep pricey

advancement.npc: Grendel the Really Old (quest: The Magician's Next Journey)
advancement.test: Take Grendel's letter to the Magician Job Instructor in The Forest North of Ellinia, enter the hidden test map, collect 30 Dark Marbles, trade for The Proof of a Hero, return to Grendel and pick F/P.

ap.summary: INT primary; LUK only to wand/staff requirements (LUK ~ level minus 7 to 10). Lv1-30 near-pure INT with 5 LUK at Lv20/25/30; then 3 INT/2 LUK to Lv40, 4/1 to Lv63, pure INT after.
steps: Lv1-10: all INT (57 INT / 5 LUK).
Lv10-30: all INT except put 5 into LUK at Lv20, 25, 30 (142 INT / 20 LUK at Lv30).
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): LUK to weapon requirement, rest INT.
Alternative: pure INT with LUK from gear (budget). DEX/LUK hybrid mage is not covered by Classic sources; not recommended.
Pitfall: don't add LUK for advancement or beyond weapon requirement; check gear LUK first. INT gives no extra MP in Classic.

firstJob: Beginner: Three Snails 3, Recovery 3, Nimble Feet 3
Lv10-17: Energy Bolt to 20 (plus Improved MP Recovery 1 at Lv11)
Lv17-19: Magic Guard 3, Improved MP Recovery 3, Max MP Increase 2
Lv20-26: Magic Armor to 20
Lv26-30: Max MP Increase to 15
Alternatives: Safety (MG 15 / IMR 3 / MMI 15 / MA 8) or Low-contact (MG 3 / IMR 15 / MMI 15 / MA 8). Magic Claw is skipped in the default EB build.
Finish by Lv30; 2nd-job SP can't go into 1st-job skills.
secondJob: Lv71-100 (inference): Slow is the only skill left to fill.
Options: Poison Breath first if you hit 3+ mobs per cast; Meditation before PB for single-target farming; Teleport earlier for mobility. Don't spam Teleport at Lv1 (55 MP).
Classic changes: Fire Arrow is single-target with a 3 s burn; Poison Breath hits 6. A bug that doubled EXP and drops from burn kills was fixed Oct 15, so week-one F/P leveling reports run fast.

jobs.name: Ice/Lightning Wizard
jobs.playstyle: The fastest group killer. Thunder Bolt hits up to 6 monsters at once, and Cold Beam hits one target and slows it.
pros: Thunder Bolt is the only 2nd-job attack hitting 6 mobs (fastest mobbing per MeowDB)
Cold Beam slows and does +25% vs ice-weak mobs
Meditation party buff, Teleport
cons: Thunder Bolt costs 40 MP at max
Many Victoria mobs resist ice
Low HP; Magic Guard dependency

advancement.test: Same Magician test: instructor in The Forest North of Ellinia, 30 Dark Marbles, The Proof of a Hero, then pick I/L.

ap.summary: Same as F/P: INT primary, LUK to weapon requirements only.
steps: Lv1-30: as Magician (142 INT / 20 LUK at Lv30).
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): LUK to weapon req, rest INT.
Budget alternative: pure INT (e.g. 177 INT / 10 LUK at Lv35) using gear LUK.
Pitfall: stop adding base LUK once total LUK meets the next weapon.

firstJob: Same as Magician 1st-job plan (Energy Bolt 20 first, then MG 3 / IMR 3 / MA 20 / MMI 15).
secondJob: Option: Thunder Bolt first if you consistently hit 3+ mobs (roughly double EXP/min at Lv40 in MeowDB's benchmark). Don't use Thunder Bolt on single mobs.
Classic change: Cold Beam cast speed improved.

jobs.name: Cleric
leveling: Train on undead. Heal damages Zombie Mushrooms, Jr. Wraiths, Zombie Lupins and Wraiths, so it's your group attack on those maps.
A Cleric route: Line 1 Area 1 in the Kerning subway at 30, Ant Tunnel II at 41, Line 1 Area 2 at 50. Forgotten Hollow maps take over from Nov 18.
Malady and Dark Stone Golem are weak to holy, so Holy Arrow hits harder there. Fairies resist holy, so skip them.
Heal was cut in Classic: it restores 100% (it was 300%) and its range shrank on Oct 8. Use it to fight undead and keep your party alive, not as your only attack.
Party up whenever you can. KPQ opens at 21, and every party wants a healer.
Buy Orange Potions and Lemons for mana (about 1 MP per meso). Blue Potions cost more per point.
jobs.playstyle: Party healer. Heal and Bless keep your group going, Holy Arrow hits one target, and Invincible helps you survive on your own.
pros: Highest physical and magical EHP in MeowDB Lv70 comparison
Heal and Bless are strong party support
Heal damages undead
cons: Lowest single-target damage at Lv70
Holy Arrow is single-target only in Classic
Heal damage is much lower than pre-Big Bang; awkward targeting

advancement.test: Same Magician test (instructor at The Forest North of Ellinia, 30 Dark Marbles), then pick Cleric.

ap.summary: INT primary; keep base LUK at level minus 10 (4 INT / 1 LUK per level from Lv30).
steps: Start: 4 STR / 4 DEX / 12 INT / 5 LUK (8 of your 9 free points in INT, 1 in LUK).
Lv2-10: all INT (57 INT / 5 LUK at Lv10).
Lv11-30: all INT, except 5 into LUK at Lv20, 25 and 30 (142 INT / 20 LUK when you pick Cleric).
Lv31-70: 4 INT / 1 LUK per level (182/30 at Lv40, 222/40 at Lv50, 262/50 at Lv60, 302/60 at Lv70).
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): continue LUK = level - 10, or less with LUK gear.
Gear: Green Goldwind Shoes (+5 LUK) at Lv50 cover LUK through Angel Wings.
Pitfall: LUK above level-10 starves INT; skip Arc Staff (40 LUK too early on this plan).

firstJob: Same as Magician 1st-job plan.
secondJob: Party build: Lv30 Heal 1; Lv31 Teleport 1, MP Eater 1, Holy Arrow 1; Lv32-41 Holy Arrow to 30; Lv42-44 Heal 5, Invincible 5, Bless 1; Lv45-49 Bless to 16; Lv50-58 Heal to 30; Lv58-64 MP Eater to 20; Lv64-70 Teleport to 20.
Solo build: Heal 2 / Teleport 1 / MP Eater 1 at Lv30-31; Holy Arrow to 30 by Lv41; Heal 5 + Invincible to 20 by Lv49; MP Eater to 20 by Lv55; Teleport to 20 by Lv62; Heal to 30 + Bless 1 by Lv70.
Lv71-100 (inference): finish Bless and Invincible (party) or Bless (solo).

Classic changes: Holy Arrow now hits 1 target but M.ATK 160 (was 3 targets / 60 in test); Invincible reduces touch damage 20% at max; Bless -15% party damage taken at max (it no longer gives accuracy or avoid). Heal's range was trimmed in the Oct 8 maintenance.

firstJob.notes: Starting stats 5 STR / 12 DEX / 4 INT / 4 LUK. +22 HP / +17 MP per level; advancement +250 HP / +250 MP. 1st-job skills: Arrow Blow (20), Double Shot (20), Critical Shot (15), The Eye of Amazon (15, +range), Focus (10), Power Knockback (20). Bows are not sold in shops in Classic; most come from Woodcrafting (Vicious, Henesys).

jobs.name: Hunter
jobs.playstyle: Long-range group killer. Arrow Bomb hits up to 6 monsters and stuns them, so keep your distance and keep Booster and Soul Arrow running.
pros: #2 AoE at Lv70 and best long-range AoE (MeowDB)
Arrow Bomb hits 6 and can stun
Faster attack than crossbows; rarely has accuracy issues
Soul Arrow removes arrow cost
cons: Takes hits worst of all 10 jobs in NiaMeowDB's benchmarks
Weak when monsters get right up close
Arrow Bomb is MP-hungry (28 MP)
No movement skill; bows must be crafted

advancement.test: Take Athena's letter to the Bowman Job Instructor on The Road to the Dungeon (near Henesys), collect 30 Dark Marbles in the hidden test map, trade for The Proof of a Hero, return to Athena and pick Hunter.

ap.summary: DEX is your damage stat; add STR only to meet your bow's requirement (about 1 STR per level). Lv1-10 all DEX; Lv11-15 +10 STR and +15 DEX in total; Lv16-70 +1 STR / +4 DEX every level (70 STR for Golden Hinkel).
steps: Lv1-10: all DEX (57 DEX).
Lv11-15: +10 STR and +15 DEX in total, about 2 STR / 3 DEX a level (15 STR / 72 DEX at Lv15).
Lv16-30: +1 STR / +4 DEX per level (30 STR / 132 DEX at Lv30).
Lv31-70: +1 STR / +4 DEX per level (70 STR / 292 DEX at Lv70).
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): STR only if a higher bow needs it, else DEX.
Pitfall: don't add STR for advancement; weapon's own stats can't help you equip it.

firstJob: Beginner: Three Snails 3, Recovery 3, Nimble Feet 3 by Lv10
Lv10-18: Arrow Blow to 20 (Eye of Amazon 1-3 along the way)
Lv18-23: Critical Shot to 15
Lv23-27: Eye of Amazon to 15
Lv27-30: Focus to 10, Power Knockback 1
Variant: PKB 1 at Lv11 for close-range utility. Double Shot 0 in default build (an SP Reset later can move points into Double Shot 20).
Finish by Lv30.
secondJob: Lv31-39: Bow Mastery to 20, Bow Booster 5, Soul Arrow 1, Final Attack 1
Lv50-59: Final Attack to 30, Amazon's Judgement 1
Option: Arrow Bomb first if mobs already die cleanly. Mistake to avoid: maxing Final Attack before Arrow Bomb.
Classic changes: Final Attack 25% proc; Arrow Bomb (renamed from Arrow Bomb: Bow) hits 6 targets with a 2 s stun.

jobs.name: Crossbowman
jobs.playstyle: Ranged shots that go through a whole line. Iron Arrow pierces up to 6 monsters on long flat maps, with Final Attack and Double Shot for single targets.
pros: Iron Arrow pierces up to 6 mobs (raised from 4 in test)
Max Mastery adds +20% crit damage
Higher base W.ATK crossbows Lv50-70
Needs less STR than Hunter
cons: Slower attack speed than bows (except Heckler Lv40)
Iron Arrow loses 20% damage per pierced mob
No movement skill; wants long flat maps

advancement.test: Same Bowman test (Bowman Job Instructor, The Road to the Dungeon, 30 Dark Marbles), then pick Crossbowman.

ap.summary: DEX primary; STR = crossbow level minus 10. Lv1-15 all DEX; then 1 STR/4 DEX.
steps: Lv1-15: all DEX (5 STR / 82 DEX at Lv15).
Lv16-30: +1 STR / +4 DEX (20 STR / 142 DEX).
Lv31-70: +1 STR / +4 DEX (60 STR / 302 DEX). Gross Jaeger needs 60 STR.
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): STR to requirement, rest DEX.
Pitfall: don't follow Hunter STR numbers; crossbows need 10 less.

firstJob: Same as Bowman 1st-job plan (Arrow Blow 20, Critical Shot 15, Eye of Amazon 15, Focus 10, PKB 1).
secondJob: Lv31-39: Crossbow Mastery to 20, Booster 5, Soul Arrow 1, Final Attack 1
Lv40-49: Iron Arrow to 30, Amazon's Judgement 1
Classic changes: Iron Arrow 6 targets, renamed (was Iron Arrow: Crossbow); Final Attack 25% proc.

firstJob.town: Kerning City (beneath the Fusion Jazz Bar)
firstJob.notes: Starting stats 4 STR / 5 DEX / 4 INT / 12 LUK. +22 HP / +17 MP per level; advancement +250 HP / +250 MP. 1st-job skills: Lucky Seven (20), Double Stab (20), Nimble Body (15), Keen Eyes (15, +range), Disorder (20), Dark Sight (20).

jobs.name: Assassin
jobs.playstyle: Ranged damage, one target at a time. Throw Lucky Seven over and over with Haste, Booster and Critical Throw up, and use Drain as an emergency heal.
pros: #2 single-target and highest ranged damage at Lv70 (MeowDB)
Haste party Speed/Jump buff
Claw Mastery returns stars; Critical Recovery sustains
cons: No real mobbing until 3rd job
Stars cost mesos and inventory
Low HP and defense

advancement.npc: Dark Lord (quest: The Thief's Next Journey)
advancement.test: Take the letter to the Thief Job Instructor at the Construction Site north of Kerning City, collect 30 Dark Marbles in the test map, return The Proof of a Hero, pick Assassin.

ap.summary: LUK primary; DEX = claw requirement (about level). Lv1-10 all LUK; 1 DEX/4 LUK onward.
steps: Lv1-10: all LUK (57 LUK).
Lv11-30: mostly LUK, DEX to claw breakpoints (15 at Lv15 Steel Titans, 20, 25, 30 at Adamantium Guards): 30 DEX / 132 LUK at Lv30.
Lv31-70: +1 DEX / +4 LUK (70 DEX / 292 LUK at Lv70).
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): DEX to claw requirement, rest LUK.
Pitfall: count gear DEX first; male/female gear differences change LUK totals.

firstJob: Beginner: Three Snails 3, Recovery 3, Nimble Feet 3 by Lv10
Lv10-18: Lucky Seven to 20 (Nimble Body 3, Keen Eyes 2 early)
Lv18-23: Keen Eyes to 15
Lv23-27: Nimble Body to 15
Lv27-30: Disorder 3, Dark Sight 8
Skip Double Stab on claw builds. Finish by Lv30.
secondJob: Lv31-37: Claw Mastery to 20 (Booster 1 at Lv32)
Lv54-63: Claw Booster 10, Critical Recovery to 20
Classic changes: Haste max +30 Speed / +10 Jump (old: +40 / +20); Booster gives full 2-stage speed from Lv1.

jobs.name: Bandit
jobs.playstyle: Big damage up close. Open on a fresh monster with Steal for an ATK buff, finish it with Savage Blow, and use Double Stab when that's enough.
pros: Highest single-target damage at Lv70 (MeowDB)
Haste party buff; Steal stuns and grants +35 ATK
Shield Guard available
cons: Very short reach, constant face-tanking
Savage Blow costs 28 MP
The usual path (“Sindit”) needs a 7,000 NX SP Reset at about Lv40

advancement.test: Same Thief test (Construction Site north of Kerning, 30 Dark Marbles, The Proof of a Hero), then pick Bandit.

ap.summary: LUK is your damage stat; add DEX only to meet your dagger's requirement. Same as Assassin to Lv30, then +1 DEX / +4 LUK every level to Lv61, then all LUK.
steps: Lv1-30: as Thief (30 DEX / 132 LUK at Lv30). Reef Claw dagger at Lv30 needs 25 DEX / 60 LUK.
Lv31-61: +1 DEX / +4 LUK.
Lv62-70: all LUK (61 DEX / 301 LUK; last DEX for Kandine from gear).
Lv70-100 (inference, verify): DEX to dagger requirement, rest LUK.
Alternative: STR daggers (attack one stage faster, lower W.ATK); about equal at Lv70. Plan dagger line early.
Pitfall: extra STR/DEX for damage is wasted; LUK is the damage stat.

firstJob: Usual plan (players call it “Sindit”): take the same skills as an Assassin (Lucky Seven 20, Keen Eyes 15, Nimble Body 15, Disorder 3, Dark Sight 8), level with Lucky Seven until about Lv40, then use an SP Reset to move into dagger skills.
No-reset alternative: Double Stab 20, Nimble Body 15, Disorder 6, Dark Sight 20 (slower, melee leveling).
secondJob: Path A (reset at Lv40): Lv30-37 Haste to 20; Lv37-39 Nimble Recovery 8; Lv40 SP Reset into Dagger Mastery 20, Booster 1, Savage Blow 10; Lv41-47 Savage Blow to 30; Lv48-54 Haste refill; Lv54-58 Nimble Recovery; Lv58-68 Steal to 30; Lv68-70 Booster 9.
Path B (no reset): Lv30 Haste 1; Lv31-37 Dagger Mastery 20 (Booster 1); Lv38-47 Savage Blow to 30; then as Path A.
Lv71-100 (inference): finish Dagger Booster and Nimble Recovery to 20.
Skip: resetting at Lv30 (Lucky Seven still works well until about Lv40). Keep Double Stab after Savage Blow; it saves MP.
Classic changes: Savage Blow 4/5/6 hits by level (450% total at 30); Steal duration doubled to 60s and grants ATK; Haste +30/+10. Since the Oct 15 patch, Steal only works when it hits.

classicChanges: Level cap 100 at launch; 1st job at Lv10, 2nd job at Lv30; no 3rd job, El Nath or Orbis at launch.
1st-job advancement has no stat requirement for any class (Magician also at Lv10, not Lv8).
Every character starts with 25 AP: each stat starts at 4 and you place the other 9 (12/5/4/4 is the usual split), then +5 AP per level.
Flat HP/MP per level: Warrior +28/+12, Bowman & Thief +22/+17, Magician +16/+22, Beginner +16/+12; each job advancement adds 500 split by class. INT gives no extra MP and HP washing is not viable.
Beginner skills: Three Snails, Recovery, Nimble Feet (max 3 each, 9 SP by Lv10).

Reworked 1st/2nd job skills: Precise Strikes (warrior 1st), Max HP/MP Increase as % of base, Rush in warrior 2nd job, Power Guard moved to 3rd job, Holy Arrow single-target, Savage Blow for Bandit, Haste +30 Speed/+10 Jump.
Final Attack proc chance 25% across all classes; Slash Blast, Rush and Iron Arrow hit up to 6.
2nd-job SP cannot be spent on 1st-job skills.
AP Reset Scroll and SP Reset Scroll: 7,000 NX each (AP reset usable from Lv10).
Scroll grades: Lesser 100%, Intermediate 60%, Greater 10%, Chaos 10% (larger bonus); only Chaos can destroy an item.
Six crafting professions (Smithing, Weaponcrafting, Tailoring, Woodcrafting, Leatherworking, Arcforge), from Lv10; bows mostly crafted.
